findings.title: Exhaustive exposure removes the hidden remainder
findings.claim: The focus joins mountain removal, exposed earth, and the final negation into an exhaustive exposure: neither a person nor the terrain that could conceal a remainder remains outside the gathering.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier for leaving something behind meets wider scenes of universal assembly and accounting, while the singular carrier meets a scene in which everyone is exposed with nothing hidden; the landscape operation therefore becomes the spatial condition for the no-omission gathering.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the focus's totality as a visible clearing: removing the covering terrain and excluding an omitted person are two contacts in the same exposure.
findings.containment: The primary scene remains the movement of mountains, the exposure of earth, and the gathering of all people. The wider parallels do not make every judgment scene identical and do not add a separate claim about physical geology.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication directly supplies the three cited branch contacts; the packet's strong connection rows provide independent contextual triggers, while their retrieval labels are not treated as decisions.

branch_activations.activation: The carrier's leaving-behind relation meets the wider all-inclusive record scene, so the negation closes the possibility of an omitted remainder.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The gathering is read as deliberately complete: no person remains as an unaccounted remainder after the exposed-earth scene.
branch_activations.boundary: This activates ordinary leaving-behind, not the oath-breaking branch; the record scene is a contextual trigger, not a new lexical gloss for نُغَادِرْ.

findings.title: Every person is gathered as a singular case
findings.claim: The final negation reaches the level of each singular person: exhaustive assembly is built from the disappearance of every individual exception, not only from the presence of a crowd.
findings.mechanism: أَحَدًا is an indefinite singular carrier under لَمْ; the wider exposure scene and the exact accounting scene return through that carrier, making the no-omission claim individually inspectable.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the focus's universality has two scales at once: everyone is gathered, and no single person can remain outside the accounting.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that no one is left behind. The B001 facet supplies the singular unit only; it is not used for positive divine uniqueness or as the focus's distinct negative-person branch.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus carrier and strong contextual connections are supplied, but the originating reader walk is legacy-unbound, so the categorical individual-escape inference remains explicitly qualified.

findings.title: The later scene completes the gathering as an event
findings.claim: The later same-surah scene supplies a counterpart in which people move among one another, the trumpet sounds, and then everyone is gathered together; the focus's universal collection is therefore perceptible as an enacted reassembly.
findings.mechanism: 18:99 repeats the gathering act in an explicit collection after movement and trumpet, and its connection returns through the focus's حَشَرْنَٰهُمْ action, turning the focus's total gathering from an abstract count into a performed event.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the collection as an act that brings a moving human field into one assembled whole, not merely as a statement that a number of people exists.
findings.containment: 18:99 is a same-surah parallel rather than an identical narrative sequence. The focus still supplies its own mountain, earth, and no-omission scene, and the later event is not imported as a replacement.

epistemic.reason: The exact 18:99 Arabic and reciprocal connection are supplied, but the retrospective support is legacy-unbound, so the completion effect is retained as a qualified contextual resonance.

findings.mechanism: The ordinary leaving-behind facet and the hard-ground facet meet the focus's removed mountains and exposed earth; the supplied retrospective link to the adjacent row and no-omission book extends that physical clearance into ordered inclusion, while wider exposure and accounting parallels independently ground the contact.
findings.reader_payoff: The landscape change becomes an operation on concealment and omission: the field is cleared so that neither a hiding contour nor a person can remain as leftover material.
findings.containment: The focus retains literal mountain movement, exposed earth, and human gathering. The غ د ر branches remain contextual resonances; they do not make غ د ر mean record, and the packet does not supply direct target Arabic for 18:48 or 18:49.

epistemic.reason: The focus occurrences and wider connection rows are exact, but the main walk and its 18:48/18:49 extension are legacy-unbound retrospective evidence, so the spatial synthesis is qualified.
